# Bid the fixtures, the trench, and the extras.

> Price low-voltage landscape lighting from fixture mix, fixtures-only versus new-system versus existing-add-on, trench and soil, transformer size, and extras — plus the walk-away price a $150 / light special cannot see.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
